events.name: The Weather Prophet
events.intro: An old traveler squints at the sky, then at you. "Fronts, storms, sun that bites. I know what the road will hold. Fifty coins and I will tell you."

success.text: He taps the dirt and draws the weather in lines. You can see further ahead now.
"Wind from the west," he says. A small hint, nothing more.
He shrugs and goes back to watching the clouds.

events.name: A Rumor at the Fire
events.intro: Travelers share stories round a small fire. One lowers their voice: "Everyone says there is a place off the main road. Nobody has the same map twice."

success.text: They sketch the road ahead in the ash. Hidden stops show on your map.

choices.label: Listen and share a story of your own

success.text: Stories trade for stories. You leave with a lighter step.
Rumors rarely pay. You move on.
